about: Known findings of `census lint` (accepted, only others fail) with what to trace for each (todo, empty: nothing to do), and more things to trace no check finds (tasks). `python -m funbots_debug.census lint --todo` lists them by level. After recording: `census navpaths <map> --write --db ../../mod.db`, then lint.

tasks.todo: Optional (works at runtime since 2026-10-13): MCOM 7 stands in a ticket office (-219.9, 64.6, -531.5) behind two glass doors (south (-216.8, 65, -537.9), east (-210.4, 65, -529)) and a selling desk; the census measured it with the doors closed, the mesh doesn't reach in. The bots go to the mesh point at the east door, shoot the glass and walk round the desk (Bot:_ZoneAction, _ZoneArmDetour); armed and destroyed in the test. Leaving the office they are put out (zone_force). A helper foot path from the mesh at (-209.5, 65, -528.5) through the east door, along z -529.3 to (-216.7, 64.6, -529.6) and to the MCOM would make it smoother.

Path 5 waypoints 40-41 (-458, 70.7, 254): debris across the path (z 254, x -461..-451, gaps < 0.5 m), up to 6 bots stuck there at once. Re-record that stretch (waypoints 38-43) through the free gap at x -467, or move the waypoints there in the node editor.
Vehicle path 92 (land) waypoints 182-187 around (-25.8, 218.9, 716.3): Vodniks of base ru get stuck there (vehicle_stuck). Re-record that stretch with a Vodnik.
Vehicle path 21 (land) waypoint 124 at (-466, 89.6, 200.8): the buggy gets stuck there (4x vehicle_stuck). Re-record that stretch with a buggy.

Not recut on 2026-10-13: with the checks of the game from 2026-10-10 the mesh point (-174.5, 126.6, 44.5) at the ends of paths 43 and 81 goes, and the cut attaches them to (-169, 130.6, 43.5), 3 m higher and 10-12 m away (the kind of junction bots got stuck at on XP1_003). Look at it in the game: record a foot path from (-172.7, 127.7, 47.3) to the mesh where it really leads (or `census check` again), then `census navpaths MP_012_ConquestLarge0 --write --db ../../mod.db` and lint.
